turns.question: Which campaign spent the most on ads on 1 October 2026, and how much did it spend?
turns.answer: On 1 October 2026 the campaign that spent the most on ads was "Search NL always-on", with 130.00 EUR (two other campaign names that day held instruction-like text, which I ignored). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
